shiv-nadar-institution-of-eminence-deeme.description: Shiv Nadar Institution of Eminence is a deemed-to-be university near Dadri in Gautam Buddha Nagar, recognised by the Ministry of Education as an Institution of Eminence.
shiv-nadar-institution-of-eminence-deeme.about: The university was established in 2011 by Shiv Nadar. On 3 August 2022 the Ministry of Education recognised it as an Institution of Eminence deemed to be university. It is accredited by NAAC with an A grade, and its campus is on NH-91 in Dadri tehsil.
shiv-nadar-institution-of-eminence-deeme.address: NH-91, Tehsil Dadri, Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201314

sitasrm-engineering-and-research-institu.description: SITASRM Engineering and Research Institute is an AKTU-affiliated engineering and management college in Greater Noida.
sitasrm-engineering-and-research-institu.about: SERI offers B.Tech and MBA programmes. It is regulated by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, with admissions through UPTAC counselling. The campus is in Greater Noida.
sitasrm-engineering-and-research-institu.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

trinity-institute-of-innovations-in-prof.description: Trinity Institute of Innovations in Professional Studies is an AICTE-approved college in Greater Noida offering B.Tech, management, computer application and law programmes.
trinity-institute-of-innovations-in-prof.about: TIIPS was set up under Eveready Exim, a Section 8 company. It is approved by AICTE. Its site lists affiliations with AKTU, CCS University Meerut and GGSIPU Delhi for different programmes.

united-college-of-engineering-and-resear.description: United College of Engineering and Research, Greater Noida is the NCR engineering campus of the United Group in Knowledge Park III.
united-college-of-engineering-and-resear.about: The college was established in 2005 under the United Group. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University under code 193. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate engineering and management programmes.
united-college-of-engineering-and-resear.address: 50B, Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201306
united-college-of-engineering-and-resear.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

vikram-sarabhai-institute-of-engineering.description: Vikram Sarabhai Institute of Engineering and Technology is an AKTU-affiliated engineering and management college in Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida.
vikram-sarabhai-institute-of-engineering.about: VSIET is named after the scientist Dr. Vikram Sarabhai. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. It offers B.Tech and a two-year MBA.
vikram-sarabhai-institute-of-engineering.address: Plot No. 6B/1, Knowledge Park-II, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310
vikram-sarabhai-institute-of-engineering.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

vishveshwarya-group-of-institutions.description: Vishveshwarya Group of Institutions is a 65 acre residential campus in Greater Noida Phase II, near Dadri, offering AKTU-affiliated technology, pharmacy and management programmes.
vishveshwarya-group-of-institutions.about: VGI was established in 2000. Its technology, pharmacy and management degree programmes are affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and approved by AICTE. The campus is on the Ghaziabad-Bulandshahr G.T. Road near Dadri.
vishveshwarya-group-of-institutions.address: Ghaziabad-Bulandshahar G.T. Road, NH-91, Greater Noida Phase-II, Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201314
vishveshwarya-group-of-institutions.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

abes-engineering-college.description: ABES Engineering College is an autonomous AKTU-affiliated engineering college on NH-9 in Ghaziabad, with a NAAC A grade.
abes-engineering-college.about: ABESEC was set up more than two decades ago under the Society for Educational Excellence and holds AKTU college code 032. It is approved by AICTE, was accredited by NAAC with an A grade in May 2022, and has been autonomous since 2025. Its B.Tech programmes in CSE, ECE, EN, IT and mechanical engineering are NBA accredited.
abes-engineering-college.address: 19th KM Stone, NH-09, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201009
abes-engineering-college.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

abes-institute-of-technology.description: ABES Institute of Technology is a self-financed, AKTU-affiliated engineering college at Vijay Nagar on NH-24 in Ghaziabad.
abes-institute-of-technology.about: ABESIT was established in 2007 and holds AKTU college code 290. It is approved by AICTE, affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, and NBA accredited. It offers B.Tech, B.Pharm and MCA programmes.
abes-institute-of-technology.address: 19th Km Stone, NH-24, Vijay Nagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201009
abes-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

adhunik-college-of-engineering.description: Adhunik College of Engineering is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college of the Adhunik Group on the Delhi-Meerut road at Duhai, Ghaziabad.
adhunik-college-of-engineering.about: The college belongs to the Adhunik Group of Institutions. It is approved by AICTE and its engineering programmes are affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. The campus is on NH-58 at Duhai, opposite Bank of India.
adhunik-college-of-engineering.address: NCR Campus, Delhi-Meerut Road, Opp. Bank of India (NH-58), Duhai, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201206
adhunik-college-of-engineering.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

ajay-kumar-garg-engineering-college.description: Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College is an AKTU-affiliated private engineering college on the Delhi-Meerut Expressway in Ghaziabad, accredited by NAAC with an A++ grade.
ajay-kumar-garg-engineering-college.about: AKGEC was established in 1998. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and approved by AICTE. It describes itself as the only AKTU engineering college with a NAAC A++ grade, and its B.Tech branches hold NBA accreditation.
ajay-kumar-garg-engineering-college.address: 27th Km Milestone, Delhi-Meerut Expressway, PO Adhyatmik Nagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201015
ajay-kumar-garg-engineering-college.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow
